name: list-tasks
description: Retrieve a list of tasks filtered by project, section, tag, or assignee.

project.description: The project GID to filter tasks by

section.description: The section GID to filter tasks by

assignee.description: The assignee GID or 'me' to filter tasks by

workspace.description: The workspace GID (required when using assignee filter)

completed_since.description: ISO 8601 date to filter tasks completed since

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated list of optional fields to include
